MCP server version
items.notes: Structured roadmap tools; update board outside an active chat session.

items.title: Distribute as a Claude Code plugin
items.notes: Marketplace entry so install is one command.

items.title: Compact UI mode
items.notes: Extremely compact by default: trimmed padding, smaller type, all-caps tracked labels.

items.title: Collapsible swimlanes
items.notes: Fold columns/groups to focus on active work.

items.title: External board/ticketing integrations
items.notes: Sync with GitHub Issues, Linear, Jira, etc.

items.title: Click a card to start implementing
items.notes: Clicking a card tells Claude to begin work on that item.

items.title: Independently scrollable swimlanes
items.notes: Each lane bounded with its own scroll; page no longer overflows when lanes stack vertically.

items.title: Visual polish: Claude palette + cards
items.notes: De-bolded titles; click-to-expand descriptions (collapsed by default); warm palette matching Claude Code.

items.title: Resizable lanes (drag handles)
items.notes: Drag the border between two lanes to reallocate space; vertical handles side-by-side, horizontal when stacked. Min-size clamp prevents collapse.

items.title: Auto-stack lanes on narrow panes
items.notes: Switches to columns at >=740px, stacks below, reacting live to pane width via ResizeObserver (+ resize/interval fallbacks). Replaces the fixed media-query breakpoint.
